no-whole-pixel-floor.undoes: A — the fit uses whole pixels, so a fractional canvas cannot round into overflow
no-whole-pixel-floor.why: UNVERIFIED as necessary: no configuration tried produces a fractional canvas. jsdom boxes are whole pixels, and in Chromium 0 of 18 states at device pixel ratios 1.25 and 1.5 had one (the mutant applied, fit-check exit 0). Kept as a cheap guard; browser page zoom is the reviewers' to try.
edits:

  const h = Math.floor(box.height);

const w = box.width;
  const h = box.height;
no-whole-pixel-floor.unguarded: MEASURED by review R2: fractional canvases are common, but removing the floor changed no fit in 0 of 720 states, so no environment measured here reaches it. The floor is kept as a cheap guarantee that the sheet never lands on a sub-pixel edge (INSPECTED); no check can show it.
